verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI assistant is documented as able to 'check your calendar' and 'write drafts', and the AI connects to Calendar. That implies it could compose a reply containing your availability, but no source describes availability-sharing or inserting meeting times as a feature. missing for 10: an explicit availability-insertion or share-free-times feature, bookable meeting links or slots embedded in emails, detailed documentation of the calendar-in-compose workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
